title: Las Chivas de Milito
statementMd:
Miguel and Misael have a weighted tree with $n$ vertices. They are very proud of their tree and believe that its structure is already perfect. Aaron, however, disagrees. He thinks that the tree would be better if its connected components had smaller diameters, so he decides to modify it by removing some of its edges. For each integer $k$ from $1$ to $n-1$, Aaron wants to remove exactly $k$ edges from the tree. After doing so, the tree is divided into $k+1$ connected components.

The **diameter** of a connected component is the maximum distance between any pair of its vertices, where the distance between two vertices is the sum of the weights of the edges on the unique path connecting them. The diameter of the resulting forest is defined as the maximum diameter among all its connected components.

For every $k$ from $1$ to $n-1$, determine the minimum possible diameter of the resulting forest that Aaron can obtain after removing exactly $k$ edges.

## Input

The first line contains a single integer $t$ ($1 \le t \le 1000$) — the number of test cases.

The first line of each test case contains a single integer $n$ ($2 \le n \le 2000$) — the number of vertices of the tree.

Each of the next $n-1$ lines contains three integers $u$, $v$, and $w$ ($1 \le u, v \le n$ and $1 \le w \le 10^9$), indicating that there is an edge between vertices $u$ and $v$ with weight $w$.

It is guaranteed that the given graph is a tree.

It is guaranteed that the sum of $n$ over all test cases does not exceed $2000$.

## Output

For each test case, print a single line containing $n-1$ integers. The $k$-th integer must be the minimum possible diameter of the resulting forest after removing exactly $k$ edges, for every $1 \le k \le n-1$.
statementZhMd:
Miguel 和 Misael 有一棵包含 $n$ 个顶点的带权树。他们对自己的树非常自豪，并认为它的结构已经完美无缺。然而，Aaron 并不认同。他认为，如果树的各个连通分量的直径更小，这棵树就会更好，因此他决定删除一些边来改造它。对于从 $1$ 到 $n-1$ 的每个整数 $k$，Aaron 想要从树中恰好删除 $k$ 条边。删除后，这棵树会被分成 $k+1$ 个连通分量。

一个连通分量的**直径**是其中任意两个顶点之间距离的最大值，其中两个顶点之间的距离是连接它们的唯一路径上所有边的权值之和。所得森林的直径定义为其所有连通分量的直径的最大值。

对于从 $1$ 到 $n-1$ 的每个 $k$，求 Aaron 恰好删除 $k$ 条边后，所得森林的直径的最小可能值。

## 输入格式

第一行包含一个整数 $t$（$1 \le t \le 1000$）——测试用例的数量。

每个测试用例的第一行包含一个整数 $n$（$2 \le n \le 2000$）——树的顶点数。

接下来的 $n-1$ 行，每行包含三个整数 $u$、$v$ 和 $w$（$1 \le u, v \le n$ 且 $1 \le w \le 10^9$），表示顶点 $u$ 和 $v$ 之间有一条权值为 $w$ 的边。

保证给定的图是一棵树。

保证所有测试用例的 $n$ 之和不超过 $2000$。

## 输出格式

对于每个测试用例，输出一行，包含 $n-1$ 个整数。对于每个 $1 \le k \le n-1$，第 $k$ 个整数应为恰好删除 $k$ 条边后，所得森林的直径的最小可能值。
